user.title: De'Longhi Coffee Lounge Login
user.description: Enter the account credentials you use in the De'Longhi Coffee Lounge app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your De'Longhi Coffee Lounge password
reauth_confirm.description: Your stored login for {email} was rejected by De'Longhi's servers (e.g. you changed your password or logged out elsewhere). Enter your password once to reconnect.

error.no_devices: No machines found on this account

ble_pair.name: BLE pair
ble_pair.description: Pair a new or Wi-Fi-reset De'Longhi machine over Bluetooth and confirm the pairing with your account. Does not establish the local LAN2LAN connection.

ble_mac.name: BLE MAC address
ble_mac.description: The machine's Bluetooth MAC address, visible via a BLE scanner app while in pairing mode.

pin.name: Pairing PIN
pin.description: The 6-digit PIN shown on the machine's display.

ssid.name: Wi-Fi SSID
ssid.description: Network name to provision. Leave empty to skip Wi-Fi provisioning.

password.name: Wi-Fi password
password.description: Leave empty to skip Wi-Fi provisioning.
